label: TP
reason: User-supplied parameter name ('name') flows directly into the HTML response via 'response.getWriter().println(user ...)' where user includes the test case number derived from the parameter name. The Base64 round-trip on 'param' (which holds the value, not the name) does not sanitize the name used in the greeting. Thus, unencoded user input reaches the XSS sink.

evidence.note: Parameter name extracted from request and included in response writer without HTML encoding
